主要内容: On January 23, 2020, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. appointed John Burke as a director. Mr. Burke has served since 2017 as a Managing Partner of Vetust Advisors, providing strategic and management consulting services. Previously, he was Executive Vice President and Chief Operating Officer of Rovi Corporation (now TiVo) from 2014 to 2016, leading the transformation of content discovery, user interface, and data analytics businesses. Before joining Rovi, he led various businesses at ARRIS Group, Motorola, and General Instrument. Mr. Burke will serve as a Class II director, with a term expiring at the 2021 annual meeting. His board committee assignments have not yet been determined. The Company's board confirmed his independence under applicable rules.
